instructions.plan_boundary: Plan-blind: no plan/spec/answer history was admitted to this research pass; no plan is admitted, so plan implications are recorded as research notes only.

component_questions_derived_from_brief: CQ1 identity/context: how a read-only client identifies org/project/repo, resolves the current user, and keeps the selected review context stable as the PR changes
CQ2 versions/compare: how to enumerate review versions (iterations) and compare the selected version with earlier work
CQ3 checks/policies: how to read which checks and policies apply and what their results mean (states, blocking vs optional)
CQ4 honest incomplete data: how the provider signals absence, permission loss, throttling, truncation, and partial failure
CQ5 auth/connection: reusing the existing account choice; token kinds, scopes, transport constraints
CQ6 simpler implementation choices: request-count reductions, aggregation from single responses, architecture seams a thin plan may miss
